<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>Fractional frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by 3.5 using double-edge clocking.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractionally divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="MUL2_DIV_CLK">7</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="count" width="3">Count register to track clock cycles.</register>
        <wire id="clk_div_int" width="1">Intermediate divided clock signal.</wire>
        <wire id="clk_div_delayed" width="1">Delayed version of the divided clock.</wire>
        <wire id="clk_div_advanced" width="1">Advanced version of the divided clock.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                count <= 3'b000;
                clk_div_int <= 1'b0;
                clk_div_delayed <= 1'b0;
                clk_div_advanced <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                case (count)
                    3'b000: begin
                        clk_div_int <= 1'b1;
                        count <= 3'b001;
                    end
                    3'b001: begin
                        clk_div_int <= 1'b0;
                        count <= 3'b010;
                    end
                    3'b010: begin
                        clk_div_int <= 1'b1;
                        count <= 3'b011;
                    end
                    3'b011: begin
                        clk_div_int <= 1'b0;
                        count <= 3'b100;
                    end
                    3'b100: begin
                        clk_div_int <= 1'b1;
                        count <= 3'b101;
                    end
                    3'b101: begin
                        clk_div_int <= 1'b0;
                        count <= 3'b110;
                    end
                    3'b110: begin
                        clk_div_int <= 1'b1;
                        count <= 3'b000;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end

        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                clk_div_delayed <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                clk_div_delayed <= clk_div_int;
            end
        end

        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                clk_div_advanced <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                clk_div_advanced <= clk_div_int;
            end
        end

        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                clk_div <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                clk_div <= clk_div_int | clk_div_delayed | clk_div_advanced;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
